fichas.title: Synagogues: General Design Notes
fichas.summary: Explains the spatial and ritual organization of synagogues. The preaching rostrum (almemor) and holy ark (Aron Hakodesh) are equally significant focal elements, with an aisle for ceremonial procession between them. Orthodox layouts typically place the ark on the east wall and the rostrum in the room's center; more liberal layouts may combine and orient both elements toward the east. Women's space is symbolically separated, often on a balcony. The notes also describe handwashing facilities, the mikva, optional unobtrusive organ, and traditional symbols and ornament.
